Market today: The mood is cautious for tech and chips. Headlines show chip stocks, including Micron, are falling due to China news, and Big Tech faces consumer pushback on AI costs. This directly impacts your concentrated book.

Your holdings: QQQI and SMH are right at their stops, needing immediate attention. QQQ is also close to its stop. Your leveraged SOXL and SPAL are showing massive drawdowns, amplified by margin.

Watch: Keep a close eye on your stops for QQQ, QQQI, and SMH. Also, monitor the broader chip sector for further weakness given the China news.

Bottom line: Focus on managing risk and respecting your stops, especially with leveraged positions and margin amplifying losses.
plays: Respect your QQQI stop at 52; consider trimming or exiting if it breaks.
SMH is at its 540 stop; consider trimming as planned if it doesn't recover quickly.
Given chip weakness, consider a small hedge with SQQQ if it confirms its scanner entry at 45.49-45.34 with a stop at 45.02.
